productValidation.scope: Production working-logo family only; not a per-fixture equivalence claim
productValidation.summary: Insiders 1.143.0: five logo-only on/off pairs in each of two real states (running a command and waiting for a question). CPU results were inconclusive; input-to-frame median differences were +0.8 ms and +0.6 ms, with no consistent slowdown demonstrated. In these tests the product used a sprite atlas, unlike the SVG Draw fixture implementation. Other animations and exact confirmation/approval scenarios remain unvalidated.
